mods.name: OrbusRebornCamera
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Desktop creator camera for OrbusVR Reborn with an F2 control panel, POV, third-person, selfie and static recording modes, adjustable FOV, smoothness and distance, and optional local avatar visibility.

mods.name: OrbusQuestHelper
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Experimental client-side OrbusVR quest helper. Early builds inspect mission and journal UI; planned features include region-grouped missions, quest tracking, event alerts and fishing guidance.

mods.name: ModCore
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Core client companion installed with BepInEx by RebornManager. Provides the native Orbus Mods settings tab, automatic BepInEx configuration discovery and custom mod pages. Formerly RebornMenu; existing settings and DLL compatibility preserved.

mods.name: OrbusAbilityLabels
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Readable floating Bard and Musketeer ability abbreviations. Bright white, higher-contrast labels with improved VR text size; eight verified Bard mesh mappings and optional debug inspector (off by default).

mods.name: OrbusWeaponAdjustments
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Class-specific weapon-grip presets with Save/Load/Rename, native adjustment, protected originals, backups and recovery Trash. Offline sharing is available in v0.3.0+; custom page in RebornMenu.

mods.name: OrbusAutoMount
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Experimental auto-mount using Orbus's normal equipped-mount summon after combat ends. Starts disabled by default, with enable and summon-delay settings available through RebornMenu.
